issues.issue: Fiscal year end is an assumption; nothing on the page prints it. The extractor noted this as an assumption.

The only receipt is on a State Receipts line whose description was left blank. State aid follows the form line, but a dike and levee district's main revenue is usually property tax or levee assessments passed through the county treasurer, so the source can't be confirmed from the page. The line is already marked review.
